name: Azure SQL Database
sku: Azure SQL Database, the single-database and elastic-pool PaaS service. Azure SQL Managed Instance and SQL Server on Azure VMs are separate offerings and are not scored here.

source.oltp.note: A fully managed PaaS database engine that always runs the latest stable SQL Server engine, with high availability, in-memory OLTP and a serverless compute option.

bands.note: Microsoft handles upgrading, patching, backups (full, differential and log, with point-in-time restore), failover and replication. It manages the database's infrastructure, not yours.
Query Store records query performance, automatic tuning and recommendations flag regressions and index problems, and built-in alerting emits metrics and logs to Azure Monitor.
Central identity management for database users through Microsoft Entra integration, with multifactor authentication.

presentation.tagline: Managed SQL Server engine for application databases.
